Project Name: MHSL Hospital Expansion: PACKAGE 4 NORTH TOWER
Location Address: 17500 W. Grand Pkwy S., Sugar Land, TX 77479
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: Package 4 includes a new seven-story patient bed tower just north of the existing hospital. The tower will include ED expansion, Surgery expansion, 16-patient NICU, 14 Universal Care beds, 30 Med Surg beds, a shell floor, and mechanical penthouse.
